subject: Portal activation playbook, MSA redlines and PO field clarifications
messages:

Date: 2028-09-12T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Portal activation and contract kickoff

Hi Hannah / Laura,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. BlueMed is excited to move forward — we have two parallel tracks: (A) legal/contract alignment (MSA + order form) and (B) Ariba onboarding so our procurement system can send POs automatically.

Quick context: we run Ariba connected to SAP ECC. Important PO fields for us are: bill_to_site, ship_to_site, GL_code, tax_jurisdiction, cost_center, and PO_line_notes. Some POs are manual and will not include tax_jurisdiction.

Can you confirm:
- Do you require a signed MSA before Ariba connector activation?
- Do you have a recommended redline for the MSA / order form that we should expect?
- What PO acceptance behavior do you need on your side (do you need PO acknowledgment within X hours)?

I've attached a short sample of our PO format (PO-examples.pdf) and our standard supplier registration notes. Our target pilot go-live window is 2028-09-30 to 2028-10-07.

Thanks,
Susan Velasquez
Procurement Manager, BlueMed Health
Susan.Velasquez@bluemed.com
Attachments: PO-examples.pdf

Hi Susan — great to hear. Looping in our onboarding lead (Laura) and legal (Marissa) so we can run the two tracks in parallel.

Short answers:
- We can start Ariba test connector prior to fully executed MSA, but production acceptance for automated POs requires an executed Order Form + MSA or a signed purchase authorization (we can make a limited exception with written approval).
- I'll attach our initial MSA redline for your team to review; legal will confirm specific language requests.
- On PO ack: our platform supports automated PO acknowledgment within 2 business hours for the Ariba connector; we can confirm SLA in the order form.

Action items for BlueMed to help unblock:
1) Send a representative sample of 3 POs (we received PO-examples.pdf — thanks) showing variations (with/without tax_jurisdiction).
2) Confirm Ariba supplier ID and whether you'll provision a testing environment.
3) Please review the attached redline from Legal once Marissa shares.

I'll coordinate a quick alignment call tomorrow if helpful (30 min).

Best,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, Susan Velasquez <susan.velasquez@bluemed.com>
Date: 2028-09-13T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portal activation and contract kickoff — MSA redline guidance

Hi all,

I reviewed BlueMed's standard supplier terms and the two tracks Hannah outlined. Attached is an initial redline (BlueMed_MSA_redline_v1.docx) with comments focused on data handling, liability, and PO acceptance. High level asks from Legal:

1) Data retention & audits (MSA §9.2): we can accept a 30-90 day retention exception for support debugging, but we cannot agree to unlimited retention. Proposed language in the redline narrows retention to 90 days for logs, with explicit deletion obligations thereafter.

2) Indemnity/Cap: we propose the standard Redwood cap equal to the aggregate fees paid in the prior 12 months with carve-outs for willful misconduct. If BlueMed needs a higher cap, please provide rationale.

3) Order Form / PO acceptance: we will accept POs sent via Ariba/SFTP/Email when they contain the required minimum fields (order number, line ids, qty, unit price, currency, and buyer signature or system id). We can accept POs without tax_jurisdiction but will treat tax_jurisdiction as a non-blocking informational field — if absent, billing will use the tax jurisdiction on file for the account. We added an Order Form clause to capture this fallback.

4) EDI/SFTP: we need to scope SFTP credentials and EDI schema in the onboarding attachments. Laura — can you confirm the exact field mapping we require so I can codify it in the Order Form exhibit?

Timeline: please review the redline and return comments by EOD 2028-09-18 if possible. If there are material redlines from BlueMed, we can schedule a legal sync on 9/19.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Hannah / Team,

Thanks — we reviewed the redline and have two quick clarifying questions before our legal runs line-by-line:

1) PO acceptance: you mentioned acknowledging POs within 2 business hours with the Ariba connector. Is that a hard SLA (i.e., financial remedy if missed) or an operational target?
2) Tax jurisdiction: Our ERP sometimes omits tax_jurisdiction on low-value POs. If Redwood treats this as non-blocking, will you automatically apply the account-level tax_jurisdiction or will invoices be held?

We attached 3 sample POs (PO-examples.pdf) showing the different permutations. We can do the review and get back to you on the MSA redline by 9/18; pilot go-live still looks feasible for 9/30 pending final order-form sign-off and connector test completion.

Also — we use SFTP for EDI file drops between suppliers and our gateway. Do you support SFTP ingestion for POs / ASN?

Best,
Susan Velasquez
Procurement Manager, BlueMed Health

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-14T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Ariba field mapping, SFTP, and operational timeline (summary)

Team — internal summary following BlueMed's questions and our redline:

1) PO acknowledgement SLA: operational target is 2 business hours for Ariba-driven POs once the connector is in production. We do not offer a financial SLA for acknowledgement in the standard Order Form; if BlueMed requires a contractual SLA with financial remedies we need commercial approval (add to the deal scope).

2) Tax jurisdiction handling: as Marissa noted, tax_jurisdiction is non-blocking. If the field is absent we will map to the account-level tax jurisdiction or use the tax_jurisdiction present on the most recent accepted PO. We will not hold invoices solely for a missing tax_jurisdiction — billing will proceed and tax adjustments can be handled in invoice reconciliation.

3) SFTP / EDI: we support SFTP drops for both POs and ASNs. Required items for setup: SFTP hostname, username, key (or user/password), and agreed directory layout. We will provide an EDI mapping spec (OrderForm_PO-field-matrix.xlsx attached) and can run a test batch within 3 business days of credentials exchange.

4) Required minimal PO fields for automated ingestion: order_number, line_item_id, sku (or product_id), quantity, unit_price, currency. Optional but recommended: tax_jurisdiction, cost_center, GL_code, buyer_contact. If optional fields are missing we apply fallback logic (account defaults).

Next steps:
- Laura to send SFTP spec and field mapping to BlueMed today (ACTION).
- Hannah to confirm call time for 9/14 11:00 AM PT (we keep the sync).
- Marissa to finalize small edits to the redline for signature page and order form exhibit by 9/18.
- Rafael to reserve a connector test node for 9/25-9/29.

Attachments: OrderForm_PO-field-matrix.xlsx

Laura Bennett
Onboarding Lead, Partnerships Operations | Redwood Inference
